Gumbel-Softmax Composition (Coarse Stage) [S1]

The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly confirms every fact listed in the claim. The implementation details section confirms the shared backbone is a 4-layer MLP with 256 dimensions, the heads are three-layer MLPs, positional encoding uses ten levels for coordinates and four for directions, and the one-hot regularization module has no learnable parameters. It also states training is end-to-end from scratch without voxel or geometric initialization. The Model Analysis section confirms that 3D one-hot density regularization constrains uncertain regions, Gumbel-Softmax provides one-hot weights for compositing, 2D in-painting pseudo supervision is applied, and residual radiance composition uses a guidance field. Furthermore, the ablation studies verify that directly adding radiance fields causes the background to collapse to black, disabling 2D in-painting degrades extrapolation capability, and removing residual composition degrades metrics and decomposition quality.

*   **Strengths:** Enables explicit editing of foreground objects; disentangles background from foreground effectively [S1].

The claim states that the method enables explicit editing of foreground objects and disentangles background from foreground effectively. The evidence supports this in two ways: 1) The architecture explicitly separates the scene into 'background head' and 'object head' to generate corresponding radiance fields, which is the mechanism for disentanglement. 2) The ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of this disentanglement: removing '2D in-painting pseudo supervision' leads to 'significantly downgraded extrapolation... in the region occupied by foreground objects' and indicates the scheme helps 'local object/background disentanglement'. Furthermore, the text notes that without specific activation (Gumbel-Softmax), the background collapses, implying the designed method successfully maintains the separation (disentanglement) required for the background to be rendered correctly when the foreground is removed (as shown in Figure 8 description: 'Our background has fewer artifacts when removing the foreground object'). While the text focuses heavily on 'disentanglement' and 'decomposition', the ability to remove the foreground object cleanly (explicit editing capability) is a direct consequence of this effective disentanglement demonstrated in the results.
